title: chenopodium album subsp. pedunculare
intro: Chenopodium album subsp. pedunculare, commonly known as lamb's quarters, is a subspecies of a leafy green plant belonging to the Amaranthaceae family. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its high content of fiber and antioxidants. The therapeutic actions of Chenopodium album subsp. pedunculare include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including chlorogenic acid, quercetin, and kaempferol, contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
